summary: Delivered the docs-only close/reopen acceptance and operations runbook at BASE 1c2c6ca, grounded in the merged PH-322 delivery close implementation. docs/engineering/close-runbook.md covers: roles and four-eyes control (owner/finance execute, auditor read-only, pm project-summary-only with period pages denied, member denied, independent reviewer), the frozen objects/states (AccountingPeriod, append-only PeriodCloseRun with close/reopen + closing/closed/reopened + unique sequence, ProjectClose, DeliveryReceipt idempotency/expected_version), the precheck issue_code tables for period close and project close with blocker/warning severity and owner-specific remediation, precheck_digest binding, step-by-step period close/reopen and project close/reopen procedures (prepare, precheck, dry_run, execute, verify_integrity, evidence), exception handling for verify_integrity error codes (sequence/action_state/missing_closing_pair/dangling_closing/latest/reopen_stage) with an absolute ban on manual row edits, trigger disabling or SQL repairs, stale-version/concurrency retry rules, browser 1440/390/keyboard/empty-error-loading-disabled checklist, PostgreSQL multi-connection close/reopen scenarios, and an evidence-backfill template aligned with PH-366 (candidate SHA, precheck digest, run ref, L1–L5 layers, gaps, four-eyes signature). It states honestly that no real close/reopen drill, browser walkthrough, PG concurrency or production acceptance was executed by this slice (not_run) and that the release gate remains per PH-366. No code, migration, route, schema or gate change and no fabricated acceptance result.
